overview:
**Fire danger is Low today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, with light winds, cool temps, and recent moisture keeping fuels from drying out further.**
- Danger stays Low through the full 7-day outlook (Nov 5–11), with ERC holding in the mid-30s to high-30s percentile and BI flat near 36–38%.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect, and none of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Today's light NE winds (around 7 mph) turn calmer tomorrow, with a chance of rain/snow showers arriving after 5pm Friday, mostly cloudy, with a high near 49.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted on BLM Uncompahgre and Gunnison Field Office lands; only standard year-round fire rules remain in effect.
- The Elk Fire in Hinsdale County (northwest of Lake City) was last reported at 7,257 acres and 90% contained, with no new activity reported recently.
